title: Cries start to sound different for hunger, pain, or tiredness
summary: UNICEF says that by around 4 months a baby's cries start to sound different if the baby is hungry, in pain, or tired.
body: UNICEF Parenting says that by around 4 months, a baby's cries will start to sound different if they are hungry, in pain, or tired. The page states that as a change in the sound of the cry, not as words. It does not give a percentage of babies, so it is not the same kind of statement as a CDC milestone that names most children. A caregiver still has to check the situation. The sound is a clue on this page, not a diagnosis.

sources.title: Why do babies cry?
